literals.gloss: Mercury and Venus are at least 20° apart in ecliptic longitude on Oct 21 (00:00 UTC)
NOT: Mars and Jupiter are at least 160° apart in ecliptic longitude on Jan 21 (00:00 UTC)
NOT: the Pittsburgh Steelers won the Super Bowl played earlier that year
NOT: Mercury and Pluto are at least 160° apart in ecliptic longitude on Jul 1 (00:00 UTC)

sentence: The party holding the White House on Election Day wins if Mercury and Venus are at least 20° apart in ecliptic longitude on Oct 21 (00:00 UTC), unless Mars and Jupiter are at least 160° apart in ecliptic longitude on Jan 21 (00:00 UTC), the Pittsburgh Steelers won the Super Bowl played earlier that year, or Mercury and Pluto are at least 160° apart in ecliptic longitude on Jul 1 (00:00 UTC).
